Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync: SIs want auto-claim for large net-new leads. We need tight rules to avoid ownership ping-pong. Propose a short SLO and mapping checklist by Friday.
Jin (Sales Ops): Agree. Existing cooldown of 60d caused flips. Suggest longer cooldown and stronger matching.
Priya (SI PM): Proposed rules: cooldown = 90 days; auto-claim only if estimated_arr >= 100000 AND match_score >= 0.80; require >=2 contacts and buyer_domain present. Missing fields -> manual triage.
Rory (PartnerOps): Exclude marketplace-origin leads from auto-claim. Add lead_origin tag. Also require `playbook_id` on claim. If sales doesn't ACK claim in 72h auto-escalate to PartnerOps.
Jin (Sales Ops): Match_score should be transparent: show domain_match, crm_parent_match, fuzzy_name_score. Allow overrides with `override_reason`. Overrides that change exposure >250k need manager approval.
Maya (Partnerships): Legal check: intake shouldn't ask for NDAs. If a lead is flagged `sensitive=true`, route to Solutions Eng for pre-sales handling.
ops-bot: Draft PR created: https://go.redwood.ai/pr/si-claim-slo. Canary plan: EMEA 50 accounts, monitor duplicate_claim_rate + time_to_ack for 48h.
Priya (SI PM): I'll prepare a one-pager for SIs and an onboarding checklist with the new requirements.
Rory (PartnerOps): I'll add CRM fields: lead_origin, si_claim_ts, si_claim_status, match_score, override_reason, playbook_id, sensitive. Will run the canary next Tue 09:00 PST.
Maya (Partnerships): TL;DR: 90d cooldown, auto-claim if >=100k + match_score>=0.8 + evidence, exclude marketplace, 72h escalation, manager sign-off >250k. Merge if no objections by EOD.
